target_customer: Pharmaceutical and fine chemical process chemists who need better reaction conditions
problem: Chemists spend weeks guessing reaction parameters such as temperature, solvent, base and catalyst when making a drug or material. Existing models generalise poorly and need programming skill.
business_model: B2B software and model access for reaction optimisation at launch; the current site sells chemistry services (troubleshooting, optimisation, route scouting, library synthesis) from an in-house wet lab
product_category: ML for chemical reaction optimisation, robotic wet lab

founders.name: Jan Oboril
prior_employers: Research chemist at institutes in Czechia and Austria
education: University of Cambridge, Chemistry and Biology
founders.background_notes: YC page says he designed and sold a cell segmentation model and placed in the International Chemistry Olympiad.

competitors.name: Published chemical literature search
competitors.what: Chemists searched past reactions in the literature for similar conditions, which VentureBeat named as the main competitor

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs a model that generalises across reaction types plus roughly 20,000 experiments from a robotic lab running about 200 per day, per the April 2024 launch coverage.

defensibility.rationale: Value depends on proprietary reaction data from the robotic lab, which takes months to build, but the software layer alone is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found in searches; the company later partnered with Symeres on cross-coupling optimisation per its site.

market_need_then: The founders cite weeks lost guessing conditions and poor generalisation of existing chemical models; pharma wants to test more drugs and cheapen manufacturing (YC page).

branding.domain_note: Uses yonedalabs.com, a suffixed exact name form, no purchase story found

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical; tagline Chemistry at the Speed of Software

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found; launch coverage framed it as OpenAI for chemistry, which came from the headline, not the name.

outcome_analysis: Yoneda Labs is active with a $4M seed from Khosla Ventures in April 2024, shortly after its Winter 2024 batch. The team combined chemistry, machine learning and software skills, which helped it raise. Its site now sells wet lab services with a Symeres collaboration, so it appears to have added services around the model, but no dated pivot or later round was found.
notes: Seed amount varies by outlet: VentureBeat and Pulse2 say $4M, Vestbee and Caplight say $4.6M. Round date 2024-04-26 is from VentureBeat; the Business Wire release returned 403 and was not read. Services pivot is inferred from the site versus the YC description and is undated. No outcome news found.
